Note: The following content is restricted to employees at level P40 or above.

It's safe to say that Louis Fleming needs no introduction in this universe. The world marvels at his exceptional business acumen and strategic vision, yet few know that Mr. Fleming is also an explorer, one who has ventured to countless planets across the universe in dire need of preservation. This document compiles and records a few of the memorable tales Mr. Fleming left behind during his days as part of the Amber Lord's Support Team.

In 1302 AE, Mr. Fleming led an expedition to Jemorse, a planet long nicknamed "The Stink Ball" for the pungent odor wafting through its atmosphere. From a single breath, Mr. Fleming identified the culprit behind the odor: Enzyme-laden spores drifting through the air. He also uncovered their therapeutic value. Jemorse skyrocketed to fame as a galaxy-renowned wellness retreat. Visitors drawn to the planet reported that breathing the same air as Mr. Fleming was enough to kill any virus.

In 1305 AE, Mr. Fleming encountered a silicon-based lifeform on Ironus. It was a species whose crystalline surfaces could radiate different colors at will. By training this species, Mr. Fleming successfully achieved intergalactic lossless image transmission and founded the earliest intergalactic broadcast program. However, his voice was so excessively magnetic that it made the planet's moon drift 30 kilometers closer to its surface.

In 1314 AE, Mr. Fleming used a phase pulse grenade to kill seven leviathans, after which the grenade exploded.

In 1340 AE, Mr. Fleming and Dongfang Qixing attended a private banquet. When the banquet was short a seafood sashimi course, Mr. Fleming personally piloted a vessel down into Lushaka, hauled two fish up from thirty thousand meters beneath the sea, and convinced them to turn themselves into sashimi.

In 13██ AE, Mr. Fleming ran into the Mourning Actors troupe on the planet ██ and proceeded to have a lively exchange with the Troupe Master. The two parties shared their extensive views on the future of the universe and exchanged commemorative gifts. The Troupe Master personally painted a portrait of Mr. Fleming, with a face no one could look at directly. If one attempted to do so, they would be blinded by its amber-like radiance. The portrait is said to be preserved somewhere in the universe to this day.

In ████ AE, Mr. Fleming sat down with a Memokeeper for a long conversation, and made a promise/bet. The memories of all involved have since been wiped clean, but it did happen.

The rest of the document is inaccessible, replaced by a single warning: "Anyone found distributing this document will be charged with a Class 3 Information Crime. Please turn yourself in to the nearest Servis immediately."
